long_biography.plain_text:
At Portopiccolo, Claudio de Eccher took a construction contract and turned it into a broader development project. When the original backers could not complete the former quarry site near Trieste, the family group assumed control and finished an energy-conscious seaside village with homes, hospitality and public spaces. De Eccher described the move as a shift from contractor to developer rather than a departure from construction.

His wider role concentrated on winning work beyond Italy and financing technically demanding projects. As chief strategist and development director, he represented the group in the financing of Moscow’s VTB Arena Park and promoted specialisation in hospitals, corporate buildings, data centres, bridges and viaducts. A restructuring fund became Rizzani de Eccher’s majority shareholder in 2024; the de Eccher family retained a minority interest and continued to support the business.
